15-august.title: Independence Day
15-august.description: Every year on 15th August, Kanungo Janseva Sanstha extends support to orphanages and old age homes across Vasai–Virar by donating books, food items, and essential supplies.

Cricket-Tournament.title: Cricket Tournament
Cricket-Tournament.description: The Kanungo Boys Trophy Cricket Tournament is an annual sporting event organized every January under the banner of Kanungo Janseva Sanstha. The tournament provides a platform for young cricketers to showcase their talent, teamwork, discipline, and sportsmanship in a healthy competitive environment.

DAHI-HANDI.title: Dahi Handi
DAHI-HANDI.description: The Kanungo Boys Govinda Pathak proudly represents Kanungo Janseva Sanstha during the traditional Govinda Utsav in the Vasai–Virar region. This cultural initiative celebrates Maharashtra's rich heritage while promoting values such as teamwork, unity, courage, and dedication.

Dusshera.title: Dusshera
Dusshera.description: On the auspicious occasion of Dussehra, Kanungo Janseva Sanstha organizes a special educational support program for children from underprivileged families. School stationery, notebooks, pens, drawing materials, and other learning essentials are distributed to encourage students to continue their education with confidence.
